title: Video Editor
description:
About Made Simpler

Made Simpler exists to empower small and medium-sized businesses to grow smarter, stronger, and with real impact. We believe opportunity should not be defined by company size or available resources. With the right system in place, any business can compete, scale, and lead.

We are the world’s first Wholesale Marketing Agency , delivering Managed Marketing as a Service (MMaaS), a powerful combination of strategic human expertise and AI acceleration. Our model provides accessible, scalable, and results-driven marketing and revenue engines, leveling the playing field for growing businesses.

About the role

We are looking for a Video Editor with strong experience in Artificial Intelligence tools , capable of creating highly persuasive videos for Social Media, Ads, and institutional content.

This role requires the ability to balance human storytelling with AI efficiency, producing high-quality, scalable, and performance-driven video content.

This is a full time opportunity, 100% remote.

Key Responsibilities

  • Video editing and assembly: transform raw footage into polished, engaging, and cohesive narratives across multiple platforms, including social media, websites, and advertising.
  • Mastery of video editing tools: work with professional editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and CapCut Pro (or similar).
  • AI-powered video creation: leverage generative AI platforms to create avatars, videos, and unique visual assets, with a strong focus on tools like Creatify AI.
  • Asset organization and management: maintain efficient organization of files, versions, and workflows using tools such as Notion and Google Drive.
  • Platform optimization: adapt formats, aspect ratios, codecs, and audio levels to maximize performance across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and paid ads.

Must haves

  • Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools applied to video creation and post-production, such as Midjourney, Creatify AI, Nano Banana, Kling 3.0, Google Flow, etc.
  • Strong storytelling ability, with a solid grasp of pacing, persuasion, and visual composition.
  • Technical knowledge of video formats, codecs, compression, color correction/grading, sound design, and motion graphics.
  • Intermediate to advanced English

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python

  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 14k-20k BRL/mo (DOE).


Must Haves:

  • 3+ years of Java development experience (Java 17+ preferred)
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot
  • Proven experience supporting and maintaining large legacy systems
  • Excellent communication skills; proactive, collaborative, and user‑focused


Plusses:

  • Exposure to search technologies (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Apache Solr)
  • Experience with Python and Airflow (orchestration)
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and containerized environments


Day‑to‑Day:

As a member of this squad, you’ll focus on maintaining and supporting legacy search platforms that power at least five internal products. The role centers on working within a large, established codebase—resolving bugs, responding to outages, and ensuring overall system stability and reliability. While new feature development is limited, you’ll occasionally handle enhancement requests as needed. This role prioritizes quality, thoughtful problem‑solving, and strong communication over speed. You’ll collaborate closely with internal users, frequently engaging via Slack and participating in regular team discussions. Mid‑level engineers will primarily focus on ticket execution, while senior engineers will dive into more complex issues and mentor others—playing a key role in keeping critical systems running smoothly and efficiently.

title: Business Development Representative Mid
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the Opportunity:

Avenue Code is expanding US Business Development team and looking for a highly proactive, organized, and fluent English speaker to join as a BDR. This person will be responsible for generating qualified leads and supporting the sales team with prospecting across different business lines, including AI, cloud, staffing, and internal products.

You'll work with modern tools and automations, including AI-powered content creation to assist in outreach. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow and have a direct impact on pipeline development.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead prospecting in the US market focused on setting qualified meetings.
  • Use tools like Apollo, LinkedIn, and pre-built cadences to reach out to prospects.
  • Make cold calls when necessary.
  • Keep interactions and activities updated in Salesforce.
  • Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across many business areas (AI, cloud, staffing, etc.).
  • Partner closely with Account Executives.


Requirements

  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Previous experience as a BDR or SDR.
  • Highly organized and able to follow structured processes.
  • Comfortable using prospecting and automation tools (e.g., Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive, results-driven, and motivated by performance.


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling technology solutions (e.g., Google Cloud, AI, Salesforce).
  • Background in consulting or IT services companies.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce as a CRM.



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

Contract: Full-time (40h/week)

Compensation: USD $12,000 – $14,000 gross per year (depending on experience)

Languages: Fluent English (French is a plus)

Seniority: 3+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Support

Start Date: ASAP


We’re hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.


At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.


About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.


Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.


We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.


We’re a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.


What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified


We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French knowledge is a plus (helps with context; fluency not required)
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones


Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability


If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we’d be happy to hear from you.

title: Operations Associate - Fluent in English
description:
Operations Associate | Remote (Brazil) | U.S. Market


At Blue Dot BPO , we support U.S.-based companies in building efficient, scalable, and results-driven operations. We are looking for an Operations Associate who is analytical, highly organized, and has a strong sense of ownership to support and optimize critical operational processes in a dynamic, fully remote environment, working directly with the U.S. market.


This is a strategic position for professionals who want to grow in operations, project management, and business analysis while working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$5,000
  • Full-time Brazil contract
  • 100% remote , working directly with the U.S. market
  • Work schedule: 1 PM to 10 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term contract with growth opportunities
  • International, multicultural, and performance-driven environment


Your Responsibilities

  • Support the analysis and optimization of operational processes across departments
  • Map workflows, identify bottlenecks, and propose improvements (SOPs and best practices)
  • Support and/or manage cross-department projects, ensuring deadlines and deliverables
  • Act as a point of contact between operations, leadership, and stakeholders
  • Create operational reports, data analysis, and performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Support strategic decision-making with data and actionable insights
  • Ensure proper organization of documentation, processes, and internal communication


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or related fields
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S.-based teams and stakeholders)
  • Previous experience in operations, business analysis, or project coordination
  • Experience working with U.S.-based companies
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas)
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with multiple stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Experience with project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp)
  • Knowledge of Business Intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau)
  • Experience in startups or fast-paced environments


Work directly with the U.S. market and grow your career in an environment that values ownership, structure, and results.


Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Hiring: Financial Controller

Company: Confidential

Reports to: CEO/Owner

Status: Full-time/Contract

Location: Remote (Open to those in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia)


Position Overview

Do you love utilizing forecasts to create strategic, financial insights?

Is creating budgets, reports, and maximizing cash flow your jam?

Are you currently employed as a Controller and eager for more fulfilling employment?


Then we would like to meet you!


A small to medium‑sized financial consulting firm is seeking a Controller who can manage core financial operations and help shape the business as it grows. This role combines traditional accounting oversight with leadership of the delivery team that supports clients with financial consulting services.

You’ll be a strong fit if you work well in a fast‑paced environment, take ownership, and balance strategic thinking with precise execution.

The firm serves small businesses ranging from mid‑six to eight figures in revenue across a variety of industries. In this role, you will support both the firm and its client portfolio, ensuring strong financial systems, clear reporting, and consistent delivery across engagements.

Key responsibilities include financial statements, budgeting and forecasting, internal controls, cash flow, payroll, and financial systems management. You will also help guide the consulting delivery team by overseeing financial processes used in client work and supporting the development of scalable delivery practices.

If you enjoy building structure, improving systems, and partnering with leadership to drive growth, this Controller role will be a great fit.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare Financial Statements: Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring accuracy and full compliance with US GAAP .
  • Financial Forecasting: Build reliable forecasts to project revenues, expenses, and financial trends for both the firm and client engagements.
  • Ensure Compliance: Maintain adherence to legal, regulatory, and internal accounting policies.
  • Manage Accounting Records: Oversee accurate financial records, including AP, AR, and general ledger management.
  • Implement Controls: Develop and enforce internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure data integrity.
  • Monitor Cash Flow: Track and manage cash flow to support operational needs and strategic initiatives.
  • Optimize Cash Utilization: Create strategies to improve liquidity, cash management, and investment decisions.
  • Support Strategic Planning: Provide financial insights that guide business strategy, growth planning, and decision‑making.
  • Evaluate Financial Performance: Analyze financial results and recommend improvements to achieve organizational and client goals.
  • Oversee Financial Systems: Manage and enhance financial software and reporting systems for efficiency and accuracy.
  • US Payroll Oversight: Manage or review W2 and contractor payroll processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Lead the Delivery Team: Support and guide the financial consulting delivery team, ensuring consistent processes, high‑quality client work, and scalable operational practices.
  • Shape Operational Practices: Contribute to building and refining the firm’s financial delivery frameworks, systems, and internal processes.
  • Client Financial Services Support: Collaborate with consultants to support client financial operations and ensure strong service delivery across engagements.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of Controller or similar experience in finance or accounting
  • 3+ years of leadership experience , ideally overseeing teams or managing financial operations
  • Strong experience with US GAAP financial reporting
  • Experience with US payroll
  • Has a US CPA equivalent for Argentina, Brazil or Colombia
  • Background in client financial services or financial consulting
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability
  • Action‑oriented and solution‑focused
  • High attention to detail
  • Collaborative and proactive in working with teams
  • Ambitious, driven, and eager to grow
  • Fast learner with strong adaptability
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced consulting environment


Additional requirements:

  • Located in Argentina, Brazil, or Colombia
  • Available to work between overlapping hours with 10 AM – 6 PM US Central Time Zone
  • Access to a computer and reliable high‑speed internet
  • Distraction‑free work environment
  • Able to prioritize this role as the primary professional focus
  • Demonstrates accountability, openness to feedback, and strong ownership of work and team contributions
  • Communicates professionally and maintains a clear, respectful tone in all correspondence


Offer Details

  • Pay is relative to the market of the country you live in.
  • This is a full-time contract position


Software Utilized by Company

QuickBooks, Gusto, Microsoft Excel, Slack, Google Suite, ClickUp, Puzzle, Causal


Interview Process

  • Complete application
  • Complete assessment
  • Interview virtually with our US-based recruiting firm
  • Interview virtually with the CEO/owner
  • Paid project
  • Final interview with CEO/owner

title: Azure Data Engineer | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Analisar e compreender demandas desde sua origem;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir pipelines de dados utilizando Azure Databricks, SQL e Python;

title: Partnership Manager for Integrated Platforms
description:
About Ant International (Antom) Ant International is a global leader in digital payments and financial technology. Through our Antom brand, we empower merchants worldwide to connect with over one billion consumers via seamless, secure, and innovative payment solutions. We are driven by the mission to use technology to provide inclusive financial services for individuals and small businesses globally.


The Opportunity Are you ready to shape the future of digital commerce? Ant International is looking for a strategic and high-impact Partnership for Integrated Platform to drive our expansion in Brazil. In this role, you will be a key driver of Antom’s growth, identifying prospecting opportunities and building the foundational partnerships that will scale our presence in one of the world’s most exciting fintech markets.


Key Responsibilities: What You’ll Do

  • Partnership Development & Sales Ownership: Work with various types of partners and platforms to actively identify, prospect, develop, and close key partnerships, leading and owning the full sales process.
  • Revenue & Growth: Consistently acquire new partners and drive revenue through efficient partnerships management, ensuring agreements are closed in a timely manner.
  • Market Intelligence & Networking: Stay informed on all relevant industry trends, the competitive landscape, and customer needs, representing the company at various industry trade shows, conferences, and networking events.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with partners and internal teams to manage expectations. Work closely with technical implementation and product teams to deliver solutions based on customer needs.
  • Onboarding & Client Experience: Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to ensure clients are on-boarded as quickly as possible while maintaining an excellent client experience.


Who You Are: Required Skills

  • Experience: 8+ years of working inside TOP BR platforms or PSPs managing partnerships.
  • Networking Skills: Strong networking skills with an active network at C-level with international trade merchants within Brazil.
  • Proven Track Record: Success in delivering complex integrated sales and a history of being a relentless new business hunter with an exceptional track record of overachievement.
  • Strategic Thinking: Sharp strategic thinker who can think outside the box and adapt to fast-paced, high-growth, and complex sales cycles.
  • Sales Methodology: Knowledge of consultative/solution sales process and experience with the “Challenger” approach, including buyer profiling and risk assessment.
  • Relationship Management: Strong experience in developing and maintaining global, cultural, and long-term client relationships that sustain results.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese and full professional English proficiency. Mandarin is a strong plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree in Business/Finance.
  • An extensive network across Brazilian financial institutions and major retailers.


Why Join Ant International?

At Ant International, we thrive on innovation and global connectivity. You’ll be joining a team of builders who are redefining how the world pays and does business. If you are a visionary leader with a passion for the fintech revolution, we want to meet you.


Apply today and help us build a more inclusive financial future.

title: Analista de PCP Senior
description:
O que irá fazer:

  • Atuar no Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) de forma integrada ao planejamento de materiais e à gestão operacional de contratos de terceiros, garantindo aderência ao plano produtivo, equilíbrio entre oferta e demanda e atendimento aos prazos acordados.
  • Elaborar e revisar o plano de produção, considerando níveis de estoque, lead time de fornecedores e parceiros, sazonalidade da demanda e capacidade produtiva disponível, assegurando eficiência operacional e resposta rápida a desvios.
  • Realizar a programação diária e acompanhamento das linhas de produção de terceiros, monitorando volumes, prazos, qualidade e performance contratual, com capacidade de reprogramação diante de alterações de demanda ou restrições operacionais.
  • Planejar e controlar materiais, realizando levantamento de faltas, acompanhamento de entregas e liberações junto à área de Garantia da Qualidade, prevenindo rupturas e impactos na produção.
  • Abrir e gerenciar ordens de produção e pedidos, conforme políticas de estoque e contratos vigentes, garantindo alinhamento entre planejamento, suprimentos e operação.
  • Atender a área Comercial, fornecendo informações confiáveis sobre prazos de entrega, capacidade produtiva e viabilidade de atendimento às demandas de clientes.
  • Avaliar e revisar parâmetros de compra, manter cadastros de materiais atualizados no sistema, incluindo novos itens, produtos especiais e amostras, assegurando consistência das informações.
  • Analisar produtos de baixa movimentação, propondo planos de ação para mitigação de riscos, redução de obsolescência e descarte, com foco em eficiência e controle de custos.
  • Programar a produção de novos produtos, itens especiais e amostras, garantindo alinhamento entre áreas técnicas, comerciais e operacionais.

O que precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharias ou áreas afins;
  • Excel em nível avançado (obrigatório);
  • Experiência comprovada em PCP, Planejamento de Materiais e contratos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em ERP, preferencialmente SAP (desejável);
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado (diferencial).


Sobre a empresa: Grande porte da indústria farmacêutica.

title: Analista de PCP Senior
description:
O que irá fazer:

  • Atuar no Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) de forma integrada ao planejamento de materiais e à gestão operacional de contratos de terceiros, garantindo aderência ao plano produtivo, equilíbrio entre oferta e demanda e atendimento aos prazos acordados.
  • Elaborar e revisar o plano de produção, considerando níveis de estoque, lead time de fornecedores e parceiros, sazonalidade da demanda e capacidade produtiva disponível, assegurando eficiência operacional e resposta rápida a desvios.
  • Realizar a programação diária e acompanhamento das linhas de produção de terceiros, monitorando volumes, prazos, qualidade e performance contratual, com capacidade de reprogramação diante de alterações de demanda ou restrições operacionais.
  • Planejar e controlar materiais, realizando levantamento de faltas, acompanhamento de entregas e liberações junto à área de Garantia da Qualidade, prevenindo rupturas e impactos na produção.

  • Atender a área Comercial, fornecendo informações confiáveis sobre prazos de entrega, capacidade produtiva e viabilidade de atendimento às demandas de clientes.

  • Programar a produção de novos produtos, itens especiais e amostras, garantindo alinhamento entre áreas técnicas, comerciais e operacionais.

title: AWS Data Scientist Tech Lead | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do sistema de score de elegibilidade e risco;
  • Desenvolver, analisar e otimizar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning escaláveis;
  • Aplicar técnicas avançadas de análise de dados para geração de insights estratégicos;
  • Avaliar, monitorar e aprimorar o desempenho e a precisão dos modelos preditivos;
  • Trabalhar junto aos stakeholders na definição de requisitos de negócio e métricas de sucesso;
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e analistas para implementação das soluções;
  • Implementar soluções analíticas em ambiente AWS (arquitetura serverless);
  • Garantir qualidade metodológica, validade estatística e rastreabilidade das análises;
  • Desenvolver documentação técnica dos modelos e metodologias;
  • Conduzir discussões técnicas e disseminar boas práticas de ciência de dados.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Sólida experiência em Ciência de Dados com foco em modelos preditivos;
  • Forte conhecimento em estatística aplicada e machine learning;
  • Experiência com construção de sistemas de score (risco, crédito, elegibilidade ou propensão);
  • Domínio de Python para modelagem e implementação;
  • Domínio de SQL para análise e manipulação de dados;
  • Experiência com AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB);
  • Vivência com ambientes de dados escaláveis e arquitetura serverless;
  • Experiência com monitoramento e otimização de performance de modelos.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Arquiteto de Software (JAVA)
description:
Viva a experiência SONDA

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da SONDA?

Porque assim como você, amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.

Na SONDA você terá uma experiência de trabalho com diversas oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Um excelente lugar para aprender e contribuir para melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da tecnologia.

Procuramos Desenvolvedor e Arquiteto Java que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato 100% Remoto de 09:00 às 18:00 (SEG/SEX)

Nesta função você irá:

  • Ser profissional líder e responsável por definir e viabilizar a aplicação das melhores soluções técnicas em produtos de software que atendam aos requisitos determinados pelo cliente.
  • Pesquisar, implementar, descrever e disseminar decisões e boas práticas, prezando pela alta qualidade dos artefatos técnicos.
  • Apoia as equipes e tem interesse e habilidade em buscar e implantar soluções para os desafios técnicos dos projetos.
  • Propor normas e padrões de desenvolvimento dos produtos gerados para os clientes, validar tecnicamente as soluções de acordo à evolução dos produtos (Arq. banco de dados, componentes) para garantir a qualidade dos produtos entregues.
  • Desenvolve papel ativo como membro da divisão e na evolução das práticas e procedimentos definidos pela área.
  • Propõe e justifica as instruções do produto dentro das diretrizes aprovadas.
  • Definir as responsabilidades dos novos projetos, especifica, projeta e desenvolve softwares de acordo com os requisitos.
  • Orientação software de consulta e orientação estratégica associada ao desenvolvimento, projeto e depuração de aplicativos de software ou sistemas operacionais

Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência profissional como arquiteto ou líder técnico de projetos;
  • Experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software em ambiente corporativo.
  • Habilidades com Java >= 11, Spring Boot >= 2.5, OpenAPI, SQL e SQLServer, JS, TypeScript, Angular >= 18, REST, Git,
  • Conhecimento básico em Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Desenvolvimento de sistemas distribuídos, desenvolvimento de aplicações web e desenvolvimento para dispositivos móveis;
  • Práticas ágeis previstas em metodologias de desenvolvimento (XP, Scrum, etc);
  • Práticas de desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Práticas de gerência de configuração;
  • Conceitos e ferramentas de análise de qualidade de código;
  • TDD - Test Driven Development;
  • Arquitetura de sistemas Web (protocolos e padrões de integração, proxy, proxy reverso, WAF, CDN, servidores web, etc);
  • Protocolos de autenticação e autorização (Kerberos, OpenID, etc);
  • Administração de plataforma interna de desenvolvimento (repositório de código-fonte, ferramentas de gestão de tarefas e problemas e de avaliação de qualidade e segurança de código etc.);
  • Administração de sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux;
  • Ambientes de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Administração, configuração e distribuição de aplicações em ambiente de nuvem;
  • DevOps/DevSecOps;
  • MLOps/DataOps;
  • Segurança;
  • Nuvem;
  • Blockchain;
  • Linguagens específicas (Java, Python, Java script etc.);
  • Plataforma Microsoft 365;
  • Plataformas Low Code;
  • Ferramentas e plataformas de Inteligência Artificial e Aprendizado de Máquina;
  • Diferenciais: Experiência com IDPs e Github Enterprise.
  • Desejável: Inglês;

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!

+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração

Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Faça parte da nossa equipe!

  • Formação de ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência profissional como arquiteto ou líder técnico de projetos;
  • Experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software em ambiente corporativo.
  • Habilidades com Java >= 11, Spring Boot >= 2.5, OpenAPI, SQL e SQLServer, JS, TypeScript, Angular >= 18, REST, Git,
  • Conhecimento básico em Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Desenvolvimento de sistemas distribuídos, desenvolvimento de aplicações web e desenvolvimento para dispositivos móveis;
  • Práticas ágeis previstas em metodologias de desenvolvimento (XP, Scrum, etc);
  • Práticas de desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Práticas de gerência de configuração;
  • Conceitos e ferramentas de análise de qualidade de código;
  • TDD - Test Driven Development;
  • Arquitetura de sistemas Web (protocolos e padrões de integração, proxy, proxy reverso, WAF, CDN, servidores web, etc);

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um cliente do segmento industrial do agronegócio , com um ambiente SAP robusto e foco na evolução tecnológica em SAP S/4HANA . O projeto envolve sistemas críticos para o negócio, com atuação tanto em melhorias evolutivas quanto em sustentação, participando diretamente de iniciativas estratégicas da operação.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (RICEF) no ambiente SAP S/4HANA
  • Realizar correções de bugs, otimizações de performance e melhorias em código ABAP (Z)

  • Atuar em conjunto com analistas funcionais e áreas de negócio
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada
  • Participar de code reviews e iniciativas de melhoria contínua
  • Atuar com suporte técnico Nível 3
  • Acompanhar tendências e novas abordagens no ecossistema SAP

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento ABAP
  • Vivência com SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA
  • Experiência em objetos RICEF
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em ABAP e ABAP OO
  • Experiência com SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37 e Eclipse (ADT)
  • Conhecimento em DDIC
  • Experiência com Enhancements (User-Exit, Customer-Exit, BADIs, Enhancement Spots)
  • Desenvolvimento de relatórios ALV (Grid/Tree)
  • Experiência com SmartForms e/ou Adobe Forms
  • Noções de performance tuning em ABAP

  • Experiência com CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services e ABAP RAP

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Precisamos de um profissional PL auto-didata que conheça front-end e back-end, desejáveis React/Angular e Next.JS, Node.js e Python. O profissional vai trabalhar em conjunto com o time de IA do Fusion, deve conhecer as IDEs de mercado VS Code e Cursor e como utilizar IA, deve conhecer o uso de Prompts e RAG, e ter noção do que sao agentes de IA. Conhecimentos de banco de dados e cloud sao um diferencial. Fundamental ter conhecimentos de Design System e Figma.



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

description:
Assegurar o crescimento sustentável do faturamento e a excelência operacional nas parcerias sob sua gestão, atuando como facilitador entre as áreas internas (Crédito, TI, Marketing) e o parceiro, visando a maximização de resultados e a fidelização do ecossistema de negócios.

  • Ponto focal para agendas com os times dos parceiros.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência na área comercial com crédito B2B, ou em empresas de meios de pagamentos;
  • Pacote Office avançado (Excel, Word e Power Point);
  • Ensino Superior completo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Atuação na região do Pará e demais regiões;
  • Necessário ter veículo próprio.

title: Java Back end Developer PL/SR
description:
Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Desenvolver soluções utilizando programação Java orientada a objetos, aplicando Design Patterns adequados ao contexto;
  • Implementar aplicações e serviços REST, garantindo padronização, segurança e eficiência na comunicação entre sistemas;
  • Aplicar arquitetura e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento para assegurar modularidade, escalabilidade e qualidade técnica;
  • Atuar com Kubernetes e Spring Cloud para criação, implantação e orquestração de serviços distribuídos;
  • Integrar sistemas e serviços utilizando Kafka, garantindo comunicação assíncrona e alto desempenho;
  • Realizar testes unitários para validação de regras de negócio e manutenção da qualidade contínua do código;
  • Executar code reviews para garantir aderência às boas práticas, padrões arquiteturais e consistência entre os componentes do sistema.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento back‑end com Java orientado a objetos e Design Patterns;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações e serviços REST;
  • Conhecimento em Spring Boot e ecossistema Spring (Cloud/WebFlux desejável);
  • Vivência com Kubernetes para orquestração de serviços;
  • Experiência com integrações assíncronas utilizando Kafka;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de microserviços e ambientes distribuídos;
  • Experiência com testes unitários e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Vivência com processos ágeis e participação em cerimônias Scrum;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de integração contínua e automação;
  • Noções sobre software seguro e boas práticas de segurança.

title: Gerente de projetos
description:
Realizar a gestão de projetos analisando o contexto da empresa e do cliente e controlando os contratos, visando a sua execução e finalização, dentro dos prazos, escopo, custos, riscos e qualidade acordados entre empresa, cliente e fornecedor.


Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimentos em GIS e na plataforma ArcGIS;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Metodologias Ágil em geral e/ou pós-graduação/MBA em Gestão de Projetos e/ou experiência comprovada em Gestão de Projetos.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Conceito de metodologias de Gestão de Projetos.


Responsabilidades:

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.

Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.

At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.

We believe in and expect real teamwork, a constant drive to be better, and delivering meaningful long term outcomes that we can be proud of together.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the planning and execution of core consumer experience initiatives, ensuring projects move seamlessly from concept to launch on mobile platforms.
  • Manage the workflow for A/B testing and feature rollouts, ensuring that data, engineering, and design teams are coordinated to deliver insights rapidly.
  • Manage trade-offs effectively to deliver measurable business impact without sacrificing technical quality or team health.
  • Use project metrics to identify bottlenecks in the development lifecycle and continuously improve how we build and scale.


Qualifications


  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Proven experience managing the delivery of mobile products (iOS/Android), with a solid understanding of app release cycles and store submission processes.
  • Background in managing projects within dynamic marketplace or two-sided platform environments where dependencies are complex.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, high-stakes projects serving large user bases, ensuring stability and performance upon launch.
  • Strong command of Agile/Scrum methodologies, specifically adapted for teams that run frequent A/B tests and iterative loops.
  • Deep intuition for resource allocation—knowing how to organize backlogs and schedules to support both immediate business objectives and long-term improvements.
  • Skilled at tracking project health metrics (velocity, burn-down, cycle time) and using them to predict risks and improve predictability.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Service Technician
description:
Description

The Service Technician should be responsible to provide Aftersales support for Brazil, working from home. He/she is responsible for providing remote support, technical training for partners and on-site service when necessary. The person should be available for business trips and understand the electric and photovoltaic (solar) standards and requirements for Brazil.


Please do not apply if you do not meet the requirements!


Responsibilities

  • Handle general inquires for technical support and after sales related activities;
  • Training partners to provide daily technical support to customers over phone line, email, or face to face;
  • Solve / handle technical escalations from the customers;
  • Provide technical advice for local distributors, installers and end users;
  • Provide minor on-site inspection, commissioning, troubleshooting and replacement of defectives products, with appointments of customers in advance;
  • Keep track of in-out of replacements units;
  • Perform firmware upgrading and minor reworks in hardware locally when necessary;
  • Maintain frequent communication with management staff in Brazil;
  • Maintain a good communication with Level 2 engineers based in HQ office, in China;
  • Attend exhibitions and marketing events and introduce products and solutions;
  • Submit the related reports and documents to supervisor every week;
  • Be available during work hours, from Monday-Friday, between 8-12h and 13:30-18h.


Required Skills

  • Intermediate Chinese for speaking and writring;
  • Technical degree in electricity, Photovoltaics, Renewable Energy or other comparable course;
  • Advanced knowledge of PV Inverters (on-grid and storage);
  • At least 1 year of experience with PV inverters;
  • Experience with DG (Distributed Generation);
  • Basic knowledge in sizing electrical circuits, PV arrangement, protection circuits, and interpretation of electrical diagrams;
  • Knowledge about Brazilian regulation on PV;
  • MS Office.
  • English speaking


Optional Skills (If you have them, it’s a Plus!)

  • Spanish speaking;
  • Experience with PV Large Utility-Scale;
  • Experience with lead-acid and lithium batteries for PV storage systems;
  • Zendesk experience;
  • NeoCRM experience.


Attributions

  • Excellent organization skills with the ability to quickly assess priorities;
  • Proactivity, sense of urgency, team work;
  • Independence (work without direct supervision);
  • Availability for business trips in Brazil.

title: Service Technician
description:
Description

The Service Technician should be responsible to provide Aftersales support for Brazil, working from home. He/she is responsible for providing remote support, technical training for partners and on-site service when necessary. The person should be available for business trips and understand the electric and photovoltaic (solar) standards and requirements for Brazil.


Please do not apply if you do not meet the requirements!


Responsibilities

  • Handle general inquires for technical support and after sales related activities;
  • Training partners to provide daily technical support to customers over phone line, email, or face to face;
  • Solve / handle technical escalations from the customers;
  • Provide technical advice for local distributors, installers and end users;
  • Provide minor on-site inspection, commissioning, troubleshooting and replacement of defectives products, with appointments of customers in advance;
  • Keep track of in-out of replacements units;
  • Perform firmware upgrading and minor reworks in hardware locally when necessary;
  • Maintain frequent communication with management staff in Brazil;
  • Maintain a good communication with Level 2 engineers based in HQ office, in China;
  • Attend exhibitions and marketing events and introduce products and solutions;
  • Submit the related reports and documents to supervisor every week;
  • Be available during work hours, from Monday-Friday, between 8-12h and 13:30-18h.


Required Skills

  • Intermediate Chinese for speaking and writring;
  • Technical degree in electricity, Photovoltaics, Renewable Energy or other comparable course;
  • Advanced knowledge of PV Inverters (on-grid and storage);

  • Experience with DG (Distributed Generation);
  • Basic knowledge in sizing electrical circuits, PV arrangement, protection circuits, and interpretation of electrical diagrams;

  • MS Office.
  • English speaking


Optional Skills (If you have them, it’s a Plus!)

  • Spanish speaking;
  • Experience with PV Large Utility-Scale;
  • Experience with lead-acid and lithium batteries for PV storage systems;
  • Zendesk experience;
  • NeoCRM experience.


Attributions

  • Excellent organization skills with the ability to quickly assess priorities;
  • Proactivity, sense of urgency, team work;
  • Independence (work without direct supervision);
  • Availability for business trips in Brazil.

title: Strategic Finance & Investments – Analyst (Brazil)
description:
Location: Remote (Latin America only – Mexico, Central America, South America)

Compensation: $80,000 to $150,000 USD (base, depending on experience and location)

Experience: 1 to 7 years in Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Venture Capital

*Please apply through the Google form link at the bottom of this page.


Our Platform

We're a thematic holding company backed by the Pritzker Organization focused exclusively on acquiring and scaling category-defining software businesses. Our structure organizes investments into focused portfolios that function as specialized operating groups, each developing deep domain expertise, proven operational playbooks and long-term partnerships with founders and management teams.


We combine operational rigor with a growth equity mindset - partnering closely with leadership teams to drive sustainable ARR growth, profitability improvements and industry-leading customer outcomes.

Our current investment portfolios include:

  • Emergence Mobility Technologies (AutoTech) – Next-generation vehicle acquisition and inventory management platforms
  • Emergence Healthcare Technologies (HCIT) – High-efficiency billing optimization, patient engagement, and clinical care software
  • Emergence Container Technologies (Cloud Infrastructure) – Modern DevOps, observability, and secure cloud performance tools
  • Emergence Procurement Technologies (Supply Chain Tech) – Procurement, logistics, and manufacturing visibility systems


The Role

Strategic Finance & Investments – Analyst

  • Finance at Emergence is not “reporting after the fact.” It is how we make decisions. The bar is high because the work gets used in real rooms with real stakes.
  • This is a hybrid role that sits between investing and strategic finance. You will help build the financial engine across more than 10+ growing portfolio companies in different sectors, including Auto, Healthcare, and Infrastructure Software.
  • It is a great seat for someone early in their career who wants real reps, fast feedback, and a lot of ownership. You will learn quickly because you will have to. You will also get exposed to the CEO and CFO level across U.S. software businesses in addition to the management team at Emergence.


What You Will Spend Your Time Doing

You will do a mix of hands-on building and higher-level thinking, including:

  • Building and maintaining detailed operating models used to forecast performance and guide decisions (revenue, retention, pricing, hiring plans, cash, and scenarios)
  • Standing up “finance infrastructure” that actually works across portfolio companies, including reporting packages, KPI dashboards, budget versus actuals, and forecasting cadences
  • Supporting investor and capital raise work, including preparing materials, cleaning up data rooms, and tightening the metrics story so it holds up under scrutiny
  • Working closely with accounting leaders to improve the quality of the numbers (close hygiene, chart of accounts structure, consistency of definitions, and data integrity)
  • Contributing to new M&A theses and diligence, including market research, unit economics work, and translating messy diligence inputs into clear decision memos


What Makes Someone Successful Here

This is not a role where you can hide behind “good effort.” The models either tie out or they do not.

People who do well here tend to:

  • Take pride in accuracy and consistency, even on the unglamorous stuff
  • Catch issues early and fix them without needing a lot of airtime
  • Ask sharp questions and then go do the work to answer them
  • Communicate clearly in English, both in writing and live, because you will work with U.S.-based executives and investors
  • Stay calm when priorities shift, and still deliver something clean


Requirements

  • 1 to 7 years of IB, PE, or VC experience (or an extremely close equivalent)
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including building models from scratch and stress-testing assumptions
  • Solid accounting and finance fundamentals (you do not need to be a CPA, but you do need to know what you are looking at)
  • Ability to overlap meaningfully with U.S. working hours

A Honeymooners é uma agência internacional especializada em luas de mel e viagens de alto valor , com forte presença no mercado dos EUA.


Esta não é uma vaga para atendimento turístico tradicional.

É para quem sabe aconselhar, conduzir decisões e vender viagens internacionais personalizadas a casais exigentes.

• Trabalhar em articulação com a equipa interna de pós-vendas e orçamentação;

• Apresentar soluções de viagem personalizadas e conduzir o processo até ao fecho;

• Fazer follow-up estruturado e consistente;

• Trabalhar com metas claras de vendas;

• Registar toda a atividade no CRM.

Procuramos profissionais que:

• Tenham experiência real como consultor(a) de viagens ou em vendas de viagens personalizadas;

• Estejam confortáveis a vender viagens internacionais de valor médio/alto;

• Comuniquem em inglês funcional e confiante;

• Gostem de trabalhar com metas, ritmo e responsabilidade;

• Prefiram ganhar mais por performance do que ter garantias fixas;

• Tenham postura consultiva, mas saibam conduzir decisões;

• Não fiquem confortáveis sem pipeline ativo.


Esta vaga NÃO é indicada se:

• Procuras apenas atendimento ou operação turística;

• Precisas de salário alto garantido desde o primeiro mês;

• Não gostas de metas ou avaliação de performance;

• Preferes um ambiente previsível e sem pressão;

• Procuras um ritmo “tranquilo”.

⸻

Modelo de trabalho:

• Full-time;

• 100% remoto;

• Horário alinhado com o mercado dos EUA.

⸻

Processo de Recrutamento:

• Conversa inicial (perfil, ambição e fit);

• Simulação prática de atendimento/consultoria de viagem;

• Decisão rápida.

⸻

Oferecemos:

• Salário base + US$ 150 por cada lua de mel vendida;

• Modelo orientado a performance, com upside real para quem anda;

• Crescimento financeiro associado a resultados e consistência.
